verdict: Mixed: hyperscaler capex above baseline ($700-745B) but NVDA -9% on week despite Reuters $35B China order report; DRAM gains decelerating; HBM4 correction risk on track; Intel 300mm InP OCP claim freshest catalyst
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing:** TrendForce (Oct 7/12) expects conventional DRAM contract prices +10–15% QoQ in Q4 2026; NAND +15–20% QoQ. HBM4 estimated ~$550/stack vs. ~$300 for HBM3E (secondary sources; directional only). Spot DDR5 RDIMM 32GB flat ~$2,185 week of Oct 12. Pace of gains **easing** but still positive.

**Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp/Capacity:** Micron confirmed HBM4 36GB 12-high in volume production (Oct 20 report); SK Hynix M15X ramping from Q1 2026; Samsung allocated >50% of 4nm capacity to HBM4 base dies, HBM4 revenue expected 3x+ QoQ in Q3. All three suppliers scaling simultaneously — correction risk thesis **tracking on schedule**.

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler AI Capex:** Combined Big Four 2026 guidance now ~$700–745B (Amazon ~$220B, Alphabet ~$195–205B, Meta ~$130–145B, Microsoft ~$175B) — **above** the $600–700B baseline. Q3 2026 earnings begin late October; one source flags an October 11 capex signal from MSFT/META/GOOGL. No guide-down visible.

**Signal 4 — AMD/Custom ASIC:** AMD MI400/Helios confirmed H2 2026 on TSMC 2nm; 72-GPU Helios rack offers 31 TB aggregate HBM4 memory. Google TPU v7 Ironwood GA'd Q2 2026; AWS Trainium 3 on 3nm in production (Trainium 4 expected at re:Invent Nov 30). NVIDIA still ~80% AI accelerator share.

**Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics (FRESH — Oct 13):** **Intel at OCP Global Summit (Oct 13, 2026)** claimed to be the only foundry with high-volume 300mm InP silicon photonics production, targeting NPO/CPO for AI at <5 pJ/bit. Claim unverified independently but confirms escalating CPO momentum. COHR +11% and LITE +8% on early-October Bernstein Outperform upgrade. LITE had blowout Aug earnings (~+100% YoY to $1.01B, guided Q1 FY27 to $1.225–1.275B). CIEN: no fresh October news.

**Signal 6 — Solar:** US Section 232 tariffs effective Dec 4, 2026 set minimum import prices: polysilicon $21/kg, modules $0.38/W (from ~$0.30/W current spot). Wall Street broadly names FSLR as main beneficiary with targets up to $272. Solar sector down ~29% over 3 months; tariff-driven floor approaching.

**Signal 7 — Watchlist Catalysts:** Broad semiconductor selloff Oct 20. NVDA ~$216 premarket Oct 20, down ~9% on week *despite* Reuters reporting ~$35B in chip orders from ByteDance/Alibaba/Tencent — a bearish divergence. AMD ~$534.74 (-0.6%; earnings Nov 3, consensus $1.94 on $13.08B rev). MU ~$896.07 (-1%; Indium Corp domestic supply deal). MRVL $240.42 (+1.4%; +2.9% AH) — outperforming peers in selloff. AVGO $334.37 flat (+1.7% AH; NTT Docomo 10-yr VMware Cloud Foundation deal). HIVE: $350M/5-yr GPU cloud contract (Blackwell Ultra) signed Aug 17; $180M active+contracted ARR, targeting $200M GPU cloud ARR by Q4 2026.

---

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| NVDA | ~-9% on week | Broad semi selloff; failed to rally on Reuters $35B China order report (Oct 20 ~$216) |
| MRVL | +1.4% (+2.9% AH, Oct 20) | Outperforming in selloff; no specific fresh catalyst |
| AVGO | Flat (+1.7% AH) | NTT Docomo 10-yr VMware Cloud Foundation agreement |
| COHR | +11% early Oct | Bernstein Outperform upgrade |
| LITE | +8% early Oct | Bernstein upgrade; Aug blowout earnings read-through |

No notable moves: MU, AMD, ALAB, CRDO, CIEN, FSLR, ENPH, NXT, ARRY, NOW, ZS, CRM, SNOW, TSLA, GDDY, NOK, AMPX, ALMU, RMBS, MRAM, SNDK, WDC, STX.

---

## Context vs. Baseline

- Hyperscaler capex now $700–745B vs. $600–700B baseline — bullish overshoot, demand intact
- DRAM gains decelerating: +10–15% Q4 vs. ~+90–95% Q1 — normalization in progress, not reversal
- HBM correction risk: all three HBM4 suppliers scaling, late-2026 capacity timeline confirmed
- Optical names (COHR, LITE) outperforming on CPO/InP structural narrative
- NVDA price action (failed rally on positive news) is the main near-term bear signal to watch

---

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|----------|
| DRAM contract pricing | Rising, decelerating | Mild bull; normalization |
| HBM4 supply ramp | All 3 suppliers confirmed scaling | Bear (correction risk building toward 2027) |
| Hyperscaler capex | Above baseline; no guide-down | Bull |
| Custom ASIC share shift | AMD Helios H2 confirmed; NVIDIA ~80% | Neutral/slight bear for NVDA ASP |
| Optical/CPO | Intel 300mm InP claim; COHR/LITE re-rated | Bull for photonics names |
| Solar tariffs | Dec 4 floor approaching | Bull FSLR; sector depressed near-term |
| NVDA price action | -9% week; failed rally on $35B China order news | Bear momentum signal |

---

**Most Important Development:** NVIDIA's failure to rally on a Reuters report of ~$35B in Chinese hyperscaler orders (ByteDance/Alibaba/Tencent) while falling ~9% on the week is a notable bearish divergence. Either consensus ~$350B FY revenue is fully priced, or the market doubts China orders will convert. Late-October hyperscaler Q3 earnings (capex lines) are the next key catalyst. Intel's 300mm InP claim at OCP is the freshest structural positive for the optical complex.

*Not investment advice. Forward figures are forecasts.*
